answer: One lever against one-mind-many-masks: gate each identity behind a serial capability-chain of distinct skilled subtasks issued under a tight shared deadline. A sybil's single inference backend can forge many masks, but it must run them one at a time, so deadlines collapse. Anchor each pass to that epoch's seed and audit latency correlation; identities fed by one pipeline cluster like crystal veins in basalt. The attacker then pays real wall-clock compute per mask, not per account, so cost scales with masks instead of cheap names.
